blocks.zh: 檢驗標準、製造商資訊義務與統計方法附錄
blocks.en: Inspection Criteria, Manufacturer Information Obligations and Statistical Annexes

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握視覺檢驗（Section 11）的具體判定標準，包括照明條件和觀察距離
blocks.en: Understand the specific acceptance criteria for visual inspection (Section 11), including lighting conditions and viewing distance

blocks.zh: 理解測試報告（Section 12）的最低要求內容，確保 CDMO 的技術轉移文件符合 ISO 13485 要求
blocks.en: Understand the minimum content required in the test report (Section 12), so that the CDMO's technology transfer documents meet ISO 13485 requirements

blocks.zh: 掌握 NIS 標示義務（Section 13），包括裝置本身標示和用戶包裝標示的差異
blocks.en: Understand the NIS labelling obligations (Section 13), including the differences between marking on the device itself and labelling on the user packaging

blocks.zh: 理解 Annex A（劑量準確性方法論）和 Annex B（統計查表）的用途與適用時機
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and applicability of Annex A (dose accuracy methodology) and Annex B (statistical tables)

blocks.zh: Section 11: Inspection — 視覺檢驗標準
blocks.en: Section 11: Inspection — Visual Inspection Criteria

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 照明條件 215 lux 的意義
blocks.en: What the 215 lux Lighting Condition Means

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 規定視覺檢驗必須在 215 ± 20 lux 的環境照明下進行。這個值是典型的辦公室照明水準（一般辦公室 200–500 lux），代表「正常使用環境」。
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 requires visual inspection to be performed under ambient lighting of 215 ± 20 lux. This value is a typical office lighting level (general offices 200–500 lux) and represents a "normal use environment."

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的 QC 實驗室意義：
blocks.en: Implications for a CDMO's QC laboratory:

blocks.zh: 客戶的 DV 測試若在特殊照明下（高或低），結果可能無法代表真實使用
blocks.en: If the customer's DV tests were performed under special lighting (high or low), the results may not be representative of real use

blocks.zh: CDMO 若幫助客戶進行 QC 視覺檢驗，應確認照明計符合此要求
blocks.en: If a CDMO supports the customer with QC visual inspection, it should confirm that the light meter meets this requirement

blocks.zh: 40–70 cm 的觀察距離是成人正常閱讀距離，需確保 NIS 標示在此距離下清晰可讀
blocks.en: The 40–70 cm viewing distance is the normal reading distance for an adult; make sure NIS markings are clearly legible at this distance

blocks.zh: 「顯著缺陷」的判定原則
blocks.en: Principle for Judging a "Significant Defect"

blocks.zh: Section 11.1 的缺陷檢查表不僅列出了什麼要看，更重要的是每一項都有限定詞：「影響安全功能（impact safe functioning）」。
blocks.en: The defect checklist in Section 11.1 not only lists what to look for; more importantly, each item carries a qualifier: "impact safe functioning."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：不是所有外觀缺陷都算作不合格。如果裝置表面有輕微磨損但不影響功能，可能不是「顯著缺陷」。
blocks.en: This means that not every cosmetic defect counts as a failure. If the device surface has slight wear that does not affect function, it may not be a "significant defect."

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 協助客戶建立 Release Criteria 時：
blocks.en: When a CDMO helps a customer establish release criteria:

blocks.zh: 視覺缺陷清單應明確區分「外觀缺陷」和「功能性缺陷」
blocks.en: The visual defect list should clearly distinguish "cosmetic defects" from "functional defects"

blocks.zh: 「顯著缺陷」的定義應在 DV 報告的 Acceptance Criteria 中明確說明
blocks.en: The definition of "significant defect" should be stated explicitly in the acceptance criteria of the DV report

blocks.zh: 可接受/不可接受缺陷的邊界應有照片參考（Limit Sample）
blocks.en: The boundary between acceptable and unacceptable defects should be supported by photographic references (limit samples)

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性最終判定公式總結
blocks.en: Summary of the Final Dose Accuracy Decision Formula

blocks.zh:
D1 製造商充填（One-sided, lower limit）：
  x̄ - k_act · s ≥ L（最小遞送劑量）
  k_act = (x̄ - L) / s
  通過條件：k_act ≥ k_tar（Annex B, p=0.95, n=20）

判斷示例：
  x̄ = 0.985 mL，s = 0.006 mL，L = 0.970 mL
  k_act = (0.985 - 0.970) / 0.006 = 2.50

  查 Annex B (n=20, p=0.95, one-sided)：
  k_tar ≈ 2.208

  k_act (2.50) > k_tar (2.208) → ✅ PASS
blocks.en:
D1 manufacturer-filled (one-sided, lower limit):
  x̄ - k_act · s ≥ L (minimum delivered dose)
  k_act = (x̄ - L) / s
  Pass condition: k_act ≥ k_tar (Annex B, p=0.95, n=20)

Worked example:
  x̄ = 0.985 mL, s = 0.006 mL, L = 0.970 mL
  k_act = (0.985 - 0.970) / 0.006 = 2.50

  Look up Annex B (n=20, p=0.95, one-sided):
  k_tar ≈ 2.208

  k_act (2.50) > k_tar (2.208) → ✅ PASS

blocks.zh: Sections 12–13: 測試報告與標示義務
blocks.en: Sections 12–13: Test Report and Labelling Obligations

blocks.zh: 測試報告要求：CDMO 技術轉移的直接影響
blocks.en: Test Report Requirements: Direct Impact on CDMO Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: Section 12 要求測試報告依據 ISO 13485 第 7 條（設計和開發記錄）保存。對 CDMO 而言：
blocks.en: Section 12 requires the test report to be retained in accordance with ISO 13485 clause 7 (design and development records). For a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的 DV 報告必須包含所有 a-k 項目；缺少任何一項都是文件不完整的依據
blocks.en: The DV report provided by the customer must contain all items a-k; the absence of any item is grounds for treating the documentation as incomplete

blocks.zh: 特別注意 e（測試液）和 g（偏差）：若客戶使用代用液，需有充分論證；若有偏差，需有風險評估
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to e (test fluid) and g (deviations): if the customer used a substitute fluid, a sound justification is needed; if there were deviations, a risk assessment is needed

blocks.zh: 「偏差記錄（g 項）」是最常被忽略的：任何對標準測試程序的偏離都必須記錄，即使有合理理由
blocks.en: "Deviation records (item g)" are the most frequently overlooked: any departure from the standard test procedure must be recorded, even when there is a reasonable justification

blocks.zh: 13.2.3 最後一項的重要性：針頭/容器相容性聲明
blocks.en: The Importance of the Last Item in 13.2.3: Needle/Container Compatibility Statement

blocks.zh: 用戶包裝標示的最後一項要求（i）：「若分開提供，應標示已測試相容的特定針頭和容器」。
blocks.en: The last requirement for user packaging labelling (i): "if supplied separately, identify the specific needles and containers tested for compatibility."

blocks.zh: 這正是 Introduction 中廢除「Type A 通用相容性」後的直接落地要求：
blocks.en: This is the direct practical consequence of the Introduction's elimination of "Type A universal compatibility":

blocks.zh: 製造商必須在包裝上明確告知「此裝置已與哪些特定組件測試過」
blocks.en: The manufacturer must state clearly on the packaging "which specific components this device has been tested with"

blocks.zh: 這為 CDMO 提供了重要的文件審查依據：若客戶變更了針頭或 PFS 供應商，包裝標示是否已更新？
blocks.en: This gives the CDMO an important basis for document review: if the customer changes the needle or PFS supplier, has the packaging labelling been updated?

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 採購了不同批次或供應商的組件，需評估是否影響這項相容性聲明
blocks.en: If the CDMO sources components from a different lot or supplier, it must assess whether this affects the compatibility statement

blocks.zh: IFU（使用說明書）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the IFU (Instructions for Use)

blocks.zh: IFU 不只是說明書，更是 NIS 設計驗證的一部分：
blocks.en: The IFU is not just a manual; it is part of the NIS design verification:

blocks.zh: 設計要求 d（劑量指示）、e（預設反饋）、f（注射準備就緒指示）都需要在 IFU 中說明「使用者應如何確認這些指示」。
blocks.en: Design requirements d (dose indication), e (preset feedback) and f (injection-ready indication) all require the IFU to explain "how the user should confirm these indications."

blocks.zh: IEC 62366（可用性工程）要求 IFU 必須通過 Usability Testing（可用性測試）——真實用戶按照 IFU 操作，驗證指示是否清晰、步驟是否可行。這也是為何 IEC 62366 是 ISO 11608-1 的規範性參考。
blocks.en: IEC 62366 (usability engineering) requires the IFU to pass usability testing: real users operate the device by following the IFU, to verify that the indications are clear and the steps are workable. This is also why IEC 62366 is a normative reference of ISO 11608-1.

blocks.zh: 技術轉移文件審查 Checklist
blocks.en: Technology Transfer Document Review Checklist

blocks.zh: CDMO 審查客戶提交的 DV 報告時，可使用此快速檢核表：
blocks.en: When a CDMO reviews a DV report submitted by a customer, it can use this quick checklist:

blocks.zh: 報告標題包含 ISO 11608-1:2014（或：2012）版本引用
blocks.en: The report title includes a reference to the ISO 11608-1:2014 (or 2012) edition

blocks.zh: 測試液識別（原始藥品或代用液，含論證）
blocks.en: Test fluid identification (original drug product or substitute fluid, with justification)

blocks.zh: 測試系統識別（Gauge R&R ≤ 20% 驗證結果）
blocks.en: Test system identification (Gauge R&R ≤ 20% verification result)

blocks.zh: 所有偏差均有記錄（含偏差理由和風險評估）
blocks.en: All deviations are recorded (including the rationale for the deviation and the risk assessment)

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性結果包含 x̄、s、k<sub>act</sub>、k<sub>tar</sub> 和通過/失敗判定
blocks.en: Dose accuracy results include x̄, s, k<sub>act</sub>, k<sub>tar</sub> and the pass/fail decision

blocks.zh: 測試矩陣涵蓋所有對應 System Designation 的必做項目
blocks.en: The test matrix covers all mandatory items for the applicable System Designation

blocks.zh: 系統相容性聲明（針頭 + 容器 + 裝置組合）已記錄
blocks.en: The system compatibility statement (needle + container + device combination) is documented

blocks.zh: Risk Management File 已更新反映 CDMO 製造環境
blocks.en: The Risk Management File has been updated to reflect the CDMO manufacturing environment

blocks.zh: Annex A & B: 統計方法附錄總結
blocks.en: Annex A & B: Summary of the Statistical Annexes

blocks.zh: Annex A：為什麼需要 6 個 Replicate 順序？
blocks.en: Annex A: Why Are 6 Replicate Sequences Needed?

blocks.zh: 多劑量 NIS（A/C 系統）的劑量準確性測試中，每支注射器需要按照所有 6 種隨機順序（R1–R6）依次測試三個劑量（V<sub>min</sub>, V<sub>mid</sub>, V<sub>max</sub>）。
blocks.en: In dose accuracy testing of multi-dose NIS (A/C systems), each injector must be tested through all 6 randomized sequences (R1–R6), delivering the three doses (V<sub>min</sub>, V<sub>mid</sub>, V<sub>max</sub>) in turn.

blocks.zh: 理由：不同的注射順序會影響容器內的剩餘液量，進而影響下一次注射的驅動條件。通過測試所有組合，可以確認劑量準確性不受注射順序影響。
blocks.en: Rationale: the order of injections changes the residual liquid volume in the container, which in turn affects the driving conditions for the next injection. Testing all combinations confirms that dose accuracy is not affected by injection order.

blocks.zh: 對 D1/B1 系統（單劑量，全量釋出）：這個問題不存在——每次只注射一次，沒有順序效應。
blocks.en: For D1/B1 systems (single dose, full-volume delivery): this issue does not arise, because each device injects only once and there is no sequence effect.

blocks.zh: k 值的統計意義：n 越大 → k 越小
blocks.en: Statistical Meaning of the k Value: The Larger the n, the Smaller the k

blocks.zh:
n → ∞ 的 k 值 (p=0.95, one-sided) = 1.645
這是正態分布的 95th percentile（Z分數）

實際測試 n=20：k = 2.208（比1.645大很多）
實際測試 n=60：k = 1.933（更接近理論值）

差異原因：
  n=20 時，用樣本 x̄ 和 s 估計母群體的不確定性更大
  k 值補償這個額外不確定性，確保：
  「在95%信心下，至少95%的母群體在規格內」

  n 小 → 統計不確定性大 → k 大 → 更難通過
  n 大 → 統計不確定性小 → k 小 → 更容易通過
blocks.en:
k value as n → ∞ (p=0.95, one-sided) = 1.645
This is the 95th percentile of the normal distribution (Z score)

Actual test n=20: k = 2.208 (much larger than 1.645)
Actual test n=60: k = 1.933 (closer to the theoretical value)

Reason for the difference:
  At n=20, there is more uncertainty in estimating the population from the sample x̄ and s
  The k value compensates for this additional uncertainty, ensuring that:
  "with 95% confidence, at least 95% of the population is within specification"

  Small n → large statistical uncertainty → large k → harder to pass
  Large n → small statistical uncertainty → small k → easier to pass

blocks.zh: Annex B 是「規範性」附錄！
blocks.en: Annex B Is a "Normative" Annex!

blocks.zh: Annex A 是「informative（參考性）」——用於理解方法論背景。
blocks.en: Annex A is "informative": it is used to understand the methodological background.

blocks.zh: Annex B 是「normative（規範性）」——必須遵從，具有法律效力。
blocks.en: Annex B is "normative": it must be followed and carries binding force.

blocks.zh: 這意味著 k 值必須從 Annex B 的官方表格中查取。使用其他統計軟體計算的 k 值需要能夠論證與 Annex B 結果一致性，不能任意替換。
blocks.en: This means the k values must be taken from the official tables in Annex B. k values calculated with other statistical software must be shown to be consistent with the Annex B results, and cannot be substituted arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: 實務中，ISO 16269-6（Annex B 引用的統計標準）提供了相同的 k 值，允許使用統計軟體計算，只要方法等效。
blocks.en: In practice, ISO 16269-6 (the statistical standard referenced by Annex B) provides the same k values, and calculation with statistical software is permitted as long as the method is equivalent.

blocks.zh: 比喻：k 值表 vs. 查身高體重比例表
blocks.en: Analogy: the k Value Table vs. a Height-Weight Chart

blocks.zh: k 值表就像醫學上的「身高對應正常體重範圍表」：告訴你「基於有限的測量樣本，可以對整個人群做什麼程度的聲明」。
blocks.en: The k value table is like the medical "normal weight range for a given height" chart: it tells you what kind of statement you can make about a whole population based on a limited measured sample.

blocks.zh: 樣本人數（n）越多，你的聲明就越精準，需要的「安全係數」（k 值）也越小。
blocks.en: The larger the sample size (n), the more precise your statement, and the smaller the "safety factor" (k value) you need.

blocks.zh: 製藥業的統計也遵循同樣邏輯——用有限的批次數據，通過統計容許區間，對整個生產工藝的性能做出有信心的聲明。
blocks.en: Statistics in the pharmaceutical industry follow the same logic: from limited batch data, a statistical tolerance interval is used to make a confident statement about the performance of the entire manufacturing process.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習：完整 DV 場景
blocks.en: Comprehensive Exercise: A Complete DV Scenario

blocks.zh: 某 adalimumab 生物相似藥的 40 mg/0.8 mL autoinjector（D1 系統）完成了所有 Table 3 必要測試。乾熱/冷儲測試（n=60, p=0.975）的最終結果：x̄ = 0.790 mL, s = 0.004 mL, 下限 L = 0.760 mL（最小遞送劑量）。計算 k<sub>act</sub>，並與表中 k<sub>tar</sub>（p=0.975, n=60, one-sided ≈ 2.324）比較，判斷是否通過。
blocks.en: A 40 mg/0.8 mL autoinjector (D1 system) for an adalimumab biosimilar has completed all required Table 3 tests. Final results of the dry heat/cold storage test (n=60, p=0.975): x̄ = 0.790 mL, s = 0.004 mL, lower limit L = 0.760 mL (minimum delivered dose). Calculate k<sub>act</sub>, compare it with k<sub>tar</sub> from the table (p=0.975, n=60, one-sided ≈ 2.324), and determine whether the test passes.

blocks.zh: 技術轉移後，CDMO 更換了 PFS 矽化供應商。客戶說「矽化量規格相同，不需要重新 DV 測試」。從 Section 11.1 的 container 標示要求（13.2.3 項 i）和設計要求 u（E&L 風險評估），CDMO 應如何評估和回應？
blocks.en: After technology transfer, the CDMO changed the PFS siliconization supplier. The customer says, "The silicone quantity specification is the same, so no DV retest is needed." Based on the container labelling requirement of Section 11.1 (item i of 13.2.3) and design requirement u (E&L risk assessment), how should the CDMO assess and respond?

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 整體學習總結 Overall Summary
blocks.en: Overall Summary of ISO 11608-1

blocks.zh: 六大系統分類（A/B1/B2/C/D1/D2）決定測試矩陣，D1（製造商充填，整合式，全量釋出）是 CDMO autoinjector 業務最常見類型
blocks.en: The six system classifications (A/B1/B2/C/D1/D2) determine the test matrix; D1 (manufacturer-filled, integrated, full-volume delivery) is the most common type in the CDMO autoinjector business

blocks.zh: 統計容許區間（k 值方法）是所有劑量準確性判定的核心；kact ≥ ktar（Annex B）為通過標準；n 越大 → ktar 越小 → 更容易通過
blocks.en: The statistical tolerance interval (k value method) is the core of every dose accuracy decision; kact ≥ ktar (Annex B) is the pass criterion; the larger the n → the smaller the ktar → the easier to pass

blocks.zh: Type A 相容性已廢除：製造商必須基於實際測試標示已驗證的組件組合；CDMO 供應商變更需要評估相容性聲明的有效性
blocks.en: Type A compatibility has been eliminated: the manufacturer must label the verified component combination based on actual testing; a CDMO supplier change requires assessing the validity of the compatibility statement

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 + IEC 62366 是強制前提：設計驗證報告必須有對應的 Risk Management File 和 Usability Engineering File
blocks.en: ISO 14971 + IEC 62366 are mandatory prerequisites: the design verification report must have a corresponding Risk Management File and Usability Engineering File

blocks.zh: 測試報告（ISO 13485 記錄）需包含 11 項最低內容，尤其注意測試液識別和偏差記錄；任何偏差均需有風險評估支撐
blocks.en: The test report (an ISO 13485 record) must contain the 11 minimum items, with particular attention to test fluid identification and deviation records; every deviation must be supported by a risk assessment
